purpose: Pins the ms2-lsg tables the atlas's lineage-specific-gene layers are built from, by commit AND by each table's git blob ID, WITHOUT carrying a single value. scripts/check_ms2_canon.py reads the exact bytes through git at this commit, refuses if a blob ID differs, and then compares every gene in the committed shards against them.
why_pinned_not_vendored: This repo's root was published by GitHub Pages until 2026-09-21. Pinning keeps the values out of the repo, and reading through git means a stale or feature-branch checkout cannot feed the check the wrong file: the ms2-lsg clone on this machine is routinely checked out on another session's branch.
why_blob_ids: A commit pin alone churns on every unrelated commit to ms2-lsg main. A blob ID changes only when that table's bytes change, so a moved table fails loudly by name and nothing else does.
why_the_corrections_log: Pinning tables was not enough. From 2026-09-21 to 09-26 every pinned table was byte-identical upstream while the RULING on them changed (C4 -> C5), so the check passed against a pool the owner had reversed. check_ms2_canon.py therefore also compares this blob and every table's blob with the clone's origin/main, and fails when the corrections log has moved: read the new entry, then refresh.
ruling: C5 in docs/CORRECTIONS.md (8eb65b0): the pool is the rerun that added Idesia, 776/835; only abSENSE and the synteny check are QC steps

ruling_section.why: Separates 'the rule that governs the atlas changed' from 'the log grew' (main ms2's suggestion, 2026-09-26). sha256 of the entry from its heading to the next --- rule or ## heading, computed by check_ms2_canon.ruling_section. Both failures stay failures.

what_each_table_is.pipeline/out/lsg_pool_idesia.tsv.gz: the pool: is_lsg, rank, phylostratum, tax_rep per gene (the rerun), plus the frozen call's rank
what_each_table_is.pipeline/out/lsg_pool_flags_newpool.tsv: the two C5 QC flags per pool gene (hdf_reject, tblastn_retract, unflagged)
what_each_table_is.pipeline/out/lsg_pool.tsv: the frozen 2026-04 call, superseded; provenance only (ps.frz)
what_each_table_is.pipeline/out/lsg_pool_synteny.tsv: the synteny-contest routes and DIAMOND-sensitivity stability, shown as other evidence
what_each_table_is.analyses/proteomics_translation_evidence: peptide detection per dataset x haplotype x age class

not_pinned_on_purpose: pipeline/out/lsg_pool_qc.tsv: the legacy four-flag table of the 842/883 pool; its wgd_flagged column is the flag C5 removed (main ms2, 2026-09-26).
refresh: git -C <ms2-lsg> fetch origin main; read every new entry in docs/CORRECTIONS.md; move ms2_lsg_commit to the new main, replace each blob ID with `git rev-parse <commit>:<path>`, rerun the check, and read every FAIL before accepting the move
